resources.string: Support the Belfius app on rooted devices. Modern (libxposed) module.

Print the module\'s diagnostics to logcat: guard values, audit tokens and stack traces, plus extra sanity checks on the UI layout path. Off by default — the diagnostics run inside the packer\'s audit, which the app executes on the main thread on some screens, so leaving this on can make navigation feel slow.

Belfius v26.3.0 added a second, isolated process (service o.cDe) that runs under a one-off UID, outside your root manager\'s hiding, and reports the device as rooted. With this on, the module never lets that service start. This switch is additive: the detection targets, the packer/RASP fixes and the \"Rooted: false\" override all stay installed, because they guard a different check (the app\'s in-process audit of our own hooks) that the isolated process never sees. Off (the default) is exactly the bypass this module has always shipped. v25.x and v26.1.0 ship no isolated scanner and are unaffected either way.

Takes effect the next time the Belfius app starts. From a shell you can also flip them with:\nadb shell am broadcast -a be.belfius.directmobile.android.root.SET_DEBUG --ez debug true\nadb shell am broadcast -a be.belfius.directmobile.android.root.SET_SCANNER --ez scanner true
